entries.title: Breaking News & Food4thought
entries.text: Aloha United Way just announced that an alarming 52% of Hawaiʻi households now live below the ALICE threshold. ALICE stands for Asset Limited, Income Constrained, Employed. These are families who have jobs (sometimes, two or three) and are doing everything they can to make ends meet, but are still living paycheck-to-paycheck and do not qualify for many forms of public assistance. With MORE THAN HALF of our families in this category, how might you get involved and offer support?

entries.title: Lā Kūʻokoʻa (HAWIIAN INDEPENDENCE DAY)
entries.text: All 8th graders have a mandatory event to celebrate Lā Kūʻokoʻa (Hawaiian Independence Day) tomorrow, Tue. Nov 24 in Seto during the meeting period, beginning at 10:45 am and ending at 11:40 am. ORGANIZATIONS:- --NAMI CLUB: NAMI Club Event: Take a breather and join NAMI on 11/25, Wednesday, during lunch/meeting period in Arillaga Takaki Terrace Floor Commons for a relaxing afternoon of cookie decorating! We’re featuring the viral TikTok dot cookie trend alongside a variety of other classic sugar cookie flavors and frostings. Bring a friend and unwind with us!

PUZZLES AND GAMES CLUB! Dive into exciting card and board games like Avalon, Coup, Camel Up, Set, Skull, Stratego, Chess, Uno, SushiGo, Love Letter, Decrypto, and more — everyone is welcome to join the fun during Mtg+Lunch period on Tues (11/04) in room W-308. Bring your lunch and bring along friends!

entries.title: Ted-ed
entries.text: Got an idea worth sharing? Step onto the ‘Iolani TEDEd stage. Come to the TEDEd Speaker Interest Meeting on Tuesday, December 1st during lunch in ASC-301 to learn how YOU can speak at this year’s ‘Iolani TEDed Event in April! Open to all 9th-12th grade students interested in presenting a short talk to an audience on their unique passions, insights, interests, curiosities, and perspectives. If you are interested but unable to attend the kick-off meeting, email Mr. Andrews (jandrews@iolani.org).

entries.title: Biology Club
entries.text: Struggling to understand DNA replication? Come model the process with candy at the Bio Club meeting on WEDNESDAY, Nov. 25, during meeting period! Snacks are provided, bring your friends!

entries.title: Mahjong Club
entries.text: Grs. 7-12: Join us on Tuesday, 11/24, for a Mahjong Club meeting during lunch! Take a break, catch up with friends, and enjoy a few rounds of mahjong. Hope to see you there!
